name: hud_ui_element_set_pos
description: HudUiElement::SetPos stores x and y, then invalidates through element virtual dispatch.
known_limits: tier S evidence is tracked by the grouped HudUiElement position setters VC target.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and HLIL for 0x404cd0 validate storing x at offset 0x14, storing y at offset 0x18, and dispatching Invalidate through virtual slot 8.
The native smoke verifies SetPos updates both coordinates and applies the invalidate mask.
